mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher joblessness reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as tightening monetary policy in response to rising prices pressures equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending economic slowdown and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as manufacturing weakness reduces corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as weaker housing activity reduces consumer wealth and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 1300, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as stronger manufacturing activity supports corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong labor markets and consumer confidence boost corporate revenues and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as aggressive monetary tightening suppresses economic activity and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
